title: Keep infrastructure failures out of task-success scores
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth needs a dead sandbox or broken trace to count as unscorable execution failure, not as proof the model answered incorrectly. Accepts FineEnvs reward separation guidance[^fineenvs-outcome].
implementation: `EvaluationOutcome` and `outcome_from_failure` in `mechaharness.evaluation_outcome`, with `task_trials` / `pass_at_k` in `mechaharness.eval_trial` excluding non-task outcomes from denominators.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
